analogy.rationale: Tankyrase inhibitors block TNKS/TNKS2, destabilizing AXIN and modulating Wnt/beta-catenin signaling; the closest reference class is GLI antagonist (Hedgehog/Wnt-related developmental signaling), though transcriptional effects in these cell lines are likely modest. Other kinase or epigenetic classes share only weak downstream overlap.
